steps.content: She finds herself in the same familiar corridor, now traced with a few weak lights. To the naked eye, this place is merely an anomaly of overlapping data, but to Norma's perception, it reveals itself as something else entirely.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: Last time, the data overlap was too severe for me to identify the full structure. But now I can confirm that this is the Bureau.

Through Norma's eyes, the space maps onto the Bureau with eerie precision. Only the wall signs are flipped, fire hydrants dangle from the ceiling, the Chief's office wears iron bars, and every Sinner's door gapes wide open.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: A mirror image? But not a perfect one. There are discrepancies between the two spaces.
It is as though everything that should be in order has been deliberately nudged one notch out of place.

A glance from the corner of her eye, and there it is again, that indistinct yet familiar dark shape. Its form has altered. Even Norma cannot determine whether it is the same shadow she encountered earlier.

Thrust into another Mania-warped space once more, Norma finds this one marginally more structured than the last. The logic may be skewed, but it already feels far more bearable to her meticulous mind.
But this space clearly has no welcome for her. Some external force twists and strains, trying to expel her from its boundaries...
